page_title: KOL 3-1 WER | FC Koln v Werder Bremen 12/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Tobias Reichel is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+7' 3 - 1 Mio Backhaus (Werder Bremen) latched on to a sweet pass and coolly slotted the ball inside the right post.
90+4' A cross from a corner kick by FC Koln is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
90+4' Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Mio Backhaus.
90+3' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Werder Bremen comes to nothing.
90+1' A yellow card is awarded to Eric Martel (1. FC Koln).
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
90' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for FC Koln.
90' Amos Pieper (Werder Bremen) is booked for saying more than Tobias Reichel was willing to tolerate.

90' He should have scored! Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot aimed inside the left post is pretty weak and Mio Backhaus makes an easy save. The ball is out of play. FC Koln will have a chance to score from a corner.
86' Here is a change. Sebastian Sebulonsen is going off and Rene Wagner gives the last tactical orders to Tom Krauss (1. FC Koln).
84' Leonardo Bittencourt goes off the pitch and Jovan Milosevic (Werder Bremen) comes on.
83' Jahmai Simpson-Pusey (1. FC Koln) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
80' None of the FC Koln players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
78' Daniel Thioune has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Isaac Schmidt (Werder Bremen) replacing Felix Agu.
78' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
76' Substitution. Ragnar Ache did his best and is replaced by Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln).
75' 2 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Marvin Schwabe no chance!
75' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) is going to take the penalty!
75' It’s a PENALTY to Werder Bremen after the VAR review!
75' Referee Tobias Reichel makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
75' One of the Werder Bremen players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
71' The referee is firm and issues Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln) a deserved yellow card.

68' Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The ball is out of play. Werder Bremen will take a throw-in.
67' Rene Wagner decides to make a substitution. Said El Mala will be replaced by Linton Maina (1. FC Koln).
67' Today's match ends for Jan Thielmann who will be replaced by Marius Bulter (1. FC Koln).
65' 2 - 0 After the keeper softly punches the ball away, it lands at the feet of Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln) who knows what to do with it and sends it into the bottom left corner.
65' Alessio Castro-Montes (1. FC Koln) will take a corner kick.

65' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to FC Koln.
62' Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln) bursts into the box, cuts inside his man and sends an effort just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.
58' Alessio Castro-Montes (1. FC Koln) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
55' Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mio Backhaus, who smothers the ball.
52' A cross from a corner kick by Werder Bremen is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
51' The corner is swung in but Werder Bremen can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
49' The goal by FC Koln is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
48' Celebrations by FC Koln are cut short as the referee signals that the legality of the goal will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully this won’t take too long.
47' Goal! Alessio Castro-Montes (1. FC Koln) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:0.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Rene Wagner probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Kristoffer Lund (1. FC Koln). He is replaced by Alessio Castro-Montes.
46' Daniel Thioune makes a half-time substitution. Salim Musah comes on in place of Marco Grull (Werder Bremen).
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Daniel Thioune gives a chance to Karim Coulibaly and Yukinari Sugawara (Werder Bremen) is off.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' Tobias Reichel has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+4' The resulting set piece from FC Koln is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

45+3' Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln) unleashed a rocket of a shot aiming towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save. The ball goes out of play. FC Koln are awarded a corner kick.
45+1' Isak Johannesson (1. FC Koln) places a shot at goal from the edge of the box that bends just wide of the right post.
45+1' A quickly taken corner by FC Koln.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
43' One of the players from FC Koln times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
41' A run and shot from the edge of the box by Isak Johannesson (1. FC Koln) causes Mio Backhaus little worry as it's towards the middle of the goal. Easy save.
36' FC Koln can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
36' Sebastian Sebulonsen (1. FC Koln) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
35' FC Koln have a goal-scoring opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
33' The FC Koln players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
27' It‘s a RED card, and quite right too after seeing the replay! Referee Tobias Reichel had no choice but to send Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) off. VAR seen to good effect there!
25' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident from earlier. This could be a red card for Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen)! Let's see what he decides.
24' The referee makes a totally unjustified decision to send off Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) for a rather ordinary tackle.
22' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) inside the box.
21' Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
21' It will be an indirect long-range free kick for Werder Bremen.
17' Amos Pieper (Werder Bremen) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
15' A terrific attempt by Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) from the edge of the box slides just narrowly past the right post.
14' Werder Bremen have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
11' Kristoffer Lund (1. FC Koln) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
7' 1 - 0 Goal! Said El Mala (1. FC Koln) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Mio Backhaus into the bottom right corner.
7' Said El Mala (1. FC Koln) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
7' The penalty decision stands after the VAR review. It's a penalty!
6' Wait a minute! The referee has decided to review the penalty decision using the VAR system.
6' Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!

4' Werder Bremen are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.

2' FC Koln slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Werder Bremen will have the kick-off.
Tobias Reichel will officiate today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
